name: Kingdom of Raiatea (until 1880)
description: Five horizontal stripes alternating white and red, white at the top and bottom.
history: Adopted in 1847 by the Kingdom of Raiatea and Tahaa when the Leeward Islands' independence was guaranteed. A French protectorate followed in 1880, the island was annexed on 16 March 1888 and Governor Lacascade's proclamation made the tricolour the only lawful flag.
